$description: Layout — grid (web/app margin/gutter/columns) + border-width + border-radius, re-based from Figma native export (collection 'semantic-scale', modes scale-1/2/3). Breakpoint definitions and scale->viewport mapping are PRESERVED from the Breakpoints-page doc (not carried in the variable export). Source: _raw/semantic-scale/.

scale.$description: Responsive scale modes (Figma variable modes). AUTHORITATIVE viewport mapping (Dave): scale-1 = 320-959, scale-2 = 960-1599, scale-3 = 1600+. Plus scale-1-200 = 200% accessibility text-zoom variant of scale-1 (see typography.json).

border-radius.$description: Shape tier (ADR-0010 flex slots; Dave 2026-07-21 evening: one radius CANNOT be universal — radii differ by component role, cards vs buttons; maximum flexibility, the horizon is a THEME GENERATOR where every slot is a dial). 'default' = the theme's base radius; the ROLE tokens alias it, so a theme may set ONE value (default — everything follows) or dial roles independently (Console: surface differs from control). Components bind ROLE tokens, never 'default' directly and never literals (radius gate). Role taxonomy PROVISIONAL (agent, 2026-07-21): control/surface/indicator — extend by evidence during Phase 1, not speculation. 50%/999px circle+pill idioms stay literal (deliberately round in every theme).

control.$note: Interactive elements: buttons, inputs, selects, chips/tags, selection boxes.

surface.$note: Containers: cards, dialogs/modals, menus/dropdown panels, tooltips, tables, notifications.

indicator.$note: Small status/utility marks: status chips, non-pill badges, progress tracks, kbd hints.

container.$note: Outer wrappers that HOLD other radiused things: segmented-control tracks, toolbars/segmented groups, panel shells. Distinct from 'surface' because a container's radius is the OUTER of a concentric pair — the inner thumb radius derives as container − padding (s200-D1 clause c). PROMOTED from PROPOSED SLOT to canon by s200-D2 / s200-D3 (#200, Dave, 2026-08-18); console overrides it to 20, and per s200-D3 nothing was written for mono/legacy/supercharge — they follow this base alias like every other role. ⚠ s202-D2 corrected reading (#202, Dave, 2026-08-18): the inner thumb radius no longer derives from the track PADDING — it derives from the TUNED DIAL 6, thumb = max(container − 6, 0). Padding remains a real spacing token; it simply no longer feeds the radius.

segmented-container.$description: Per-scale OUTER radius of the segmented control's concentric pair. Base = 0 (square themes: mono, legacy, supercharge). Console overrides per scale (6/8/10/12) in tokens/themes/apollo-console.overrides.json — s201-D1.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus-indicator geometry. No canonical Figma primitive — see semantic-colour.json focus group and guidelines/focus-indicators.md. SIGNED OFF as canon by Dave 2026-06-20 (was tagged review). Ring colour lives in semantic-colour.json (focus/ring).

ring-offset.$description: Gap between the element edge and the ring, px — keeps the ring clear of the component fill.

target.$description: Interactive target-size tier — the Apollo hit-area standard (RULED by Dave 2026-07-24). A control presents a hit area of at least 'min' even when its VISIBLE box is smaller; the invisible ::before target anchors within the control (9-point matrix) so it stays aligned to neighbours. 44 = HSBC default / WCAG 2.5.5 AAA / Apple HIG / IBM Carbon. Dial-down floor is 24 (WCAG 2.5.8 AA + spacing exception); never below. Reference impl: snippets/Segmented-control.reference.html (.seg button::before + .hit-*).

min.$description: Default minimum interactive target size. Controls bind --hit: var(--target-min).
